metadata.title: Supply Chain Violation & Drift Detection SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing detection, classification, and escalation of violations and drift related to supply-chain trust, enforcement decisions, and runtime behavior.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP provides independent detection of architectural violations and trust drift without enforcing or remediating conditions.

system-characteristics.system-description: The Violation & Drift Detection SSPP identifies when systems, pipelines, integrations, or devices diverge from enforced supply-chain decisions, architectural constraints, or negative-pattern prohibitions. It provides authoritative evidence of non-compliance and escalation signals without modifying system behavior.

props.name: system-role
props.remarks: Observes and records violations; does not enforce or correct.

props.name: authority-boundary
props.remarks: Detection systems must not auto-remediate or silently correct violations.

props.name: truth-source
props.remarks: Detection relies on observed facts, not declared intent or approval history.

props.name: non-equivalence
props.remarks: Approval history does not override current runtime or architectural violations.

props.name: forbidden-behavior
props.remarks: Violations must be surfaced and escalated, not normalized.

system-implementation.remarks: Violation and drift detection mechanisms correlate runtime telemetry, configuration state, pipeline behavior, and architectural topology against enforced decisions and negative-pattern definitions.

components.title: Runtime Assurance Signals
components.remarks: Provides observed runtime state and integrity data.

components.title: Enforcement Decision Baseline
components.remarks: Defines what was explicitly allowed or denied.

components.title: Negative‑Pattern Registry
components.remarks: Defines architectures and trust flows that are invalid by design.

roles.title: Detection Engineering
roles.remarks: Develops and maintains detection logic and correlation rules.

roles.title: Security Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines what constitutes drift, violation, and escalation thresholds.

roles.title: Governance & Escalation
roles.remarks: Determines response, exception, or corrective action outside the detection plane.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls align with NIST SP 800‑53r5 CA, CM, SI, IR, PL, and SR families. This SSPP emphasizes evidence creation, traceability, and escalation rather than prevention or enforcement.
